<span class="hl-comment">@dataclass(frozen=True)</span>
<span class="hl-kw">class</span> ShopOrdersData:
    id: <span class="hl-type">str</span>
    profile: <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]

    @classmethod
    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> from_dict(<span class="hl-kw">cls</span>, data: <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]) -&gt; ShopOrdersData:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">cls</span>(
            id=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;id&quot;</span>),
            profile=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;profile&quot;</span>),
        )

    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> to_dict(<span class="hl-kw">self</span>) -&gt; <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> {
